about: A paraphrase recall set for lamp-memory's kept list (#2510). Each question paraphrases one kept thing of its language without its key words; the other kept things of that language are the pool it is looked for in (16 targets and 16 distractors each). A kept thing's id is its order: a higher id is newer. Made-up content, no real people. Vietnamese is accented as Deepgram writes it. Never send it to any API.
